nodes.title: Studio browser
nodes.subtitle: User-facing client
nodes.description: Studio retains the job ID and displays progress. Production service design; local development substitutes local storage and queue adapters.
nodes.note: Fictional examples. This diagram makes no network or AI calls.
nodes.narration: Studio retains the job ID and displays progress. Production service design; local development substitutes local storage and queue adapters.

nodes.title: FastAPI
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run · user API
nodes.description: Verify bearer identity, validate the upload and orchestrate job creation. Studio calls the configured classifier API directly.
nodes.note: The API, processing, maintenance and SSE are responsibilities within one deployed Cloud Run service, not four separate services.
nodes.narration: Verify bearer identity, validate the upload and orchestrate job creation. Studio calls the configured classifier API directly.

nodes.title: Cloud Storage
nodes.subtitle: Private input objects
nodes.description: Store the uploaded statement as an immutable private object. Processing reads the persisted generation.
nodes.note: File upload and database commit are separate operations; uncertain commits retain objects that may be referenced.
nodes.narration: Store the uploaded statement as an immutable private object. Processing reads the persisted generation.

nodes.title: Job repository
nodes.subtitle: Python · PostgreSQL access
nodes.description: Persist and query owner-scoped jobs through application code. The repository is not a cloud service or queue.
nodes.note: Job service orchestrates storage and queue calls; repository code handles persistence.
nodes.narration: Persist and query owner-scoped jobs through application code. The repository is not a cloud service or queue.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL
nodes.subtitle: Supabase · durable records
nodes.description: Store profiles, jobs, attempts, outbox intents, checkpoints, ordered events and results.
nodes.narration: Store profiles, jobs, attempts, outbox intents, checkpoints, ordered events and results.

nodes.title: Cloud Tasks
nodes.subtitle: Google Cloud · delivery
nodes.description: Create a named task from the durable outbox. Queue retries and rate controls deliver processing independently of the browser.
nodes.note: Dispatch failures leave recoverable outbox work. Cloud Tasks does not guarantee execution order.
nodes.narration: Create a named task from the durable outbox. Queue retries and rate controls deliver processing independently of the browser.

nodes.title: Processing handler
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run · same service
nodes.description: Verify the Google caller, claim a fenced attempt and retrieve the stored input.
nodes.note: Duplicate active deliveries can receive 409; completed jobs are not classified again.
nodes.narration: Verify the Google caller, claim a fenced attempt and retrieve the stored input.

nodes.title: Prepare statement
nodes.subtitle: In-container · PDF / CSV
nodes.description: Convert PDFs through the reusable CPU Docling child process; CSV uses UTF-8 decoding.
nodes.note: Docling is an in-container child process, not a separate hosted service.
nodes.narration: Convert PDFs through the reusable CPU Docling child process; CSV uses UTF-8 decoding.

nodes.title: Gemini
nodes.subtitle: Hosted API · extraction
nodes.description: Extract typed statement fields and transaction rows from prepared text.
nodes.note: Paid AI call. Example output is illustrative.
nodes.narration: Extract typed statement fields and transaction rows from prepared text.

nodes.title: TypeSafe Jev
nodes.subtitle: Hosted API · classification
nodes.description: Classify the extracted transactions using the workflow criteria.
nodes.note: Paid intelligence. Classification stage progress is not per-token streaming.
nodes.narration: Classify the extracted transactions using the workflow criteria.

nodes.title: Save outcome
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run → PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Commit terminal job state, result and ordered event. Checkpoints preserve compatible completed stages.
nodes.note: Database writes are protected against stale attempts.
nodes.narration: Commit terminal job state, result and ordered event. Checkpoints preserve compatible completed stages.

nodes.title: Event listener
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run · LISTEN + replay
nodes.description: One listener connection per backend process reads durable events after each subscriber cursor. PostgreSQL NOTIFY only signals that history changed.
nodes.note: Registration/replay share a lock. Reconnect catches up from PostgreSQL; notifications are not the event history.
nodes.narration: One listener connection per backend process reads durable events after each subscriber cursor. PostgreSQL NOTIFY only signals that history changed.

nodes.title: Cloud Scheduler
nodes.subtitle: Google Cloud · maintenance
nodes.description: Invoke maintenance with its own Google service identity, including when the service has scaled to zero.
nodes.narration: Invoke maintenance with its own Google service identity, including when the service has scaled to zero.

nodes.title: Maintenance
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run · same service
nodes.description: Recover stalled work, reconcile dispatch intents and finalize exhausted jobs according to persisted deadlines.
nodes.note: Maintenance has a distinct allowed caller from processing.
nodes.narration: Recover stalled work, reconcile dispatch intents and finalize exhausted jobs according to persisted deadlines.

nodes.title: Authenticated SSE
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run → browser
nodes.description: Authorize the job owner and stream ordered events. Resume after the last event the browser applied.
nodes.note: Heartbeat comments keep the connection alive. Closing the browser does not cancel the durable job.
nodes.narration: Authorize the job owner and stream ordered events. Resume after the last event the browser applied.

nodes.title: Progress & results
nodes.subtitle: Studio browser
nodes.description: Apply events and then retain the cursor. Terminal result/error closes the stream; a refreshed client needs replay or persisted state.
nodes.narration: Apply events and then retain the cursor. Terminal result/error closes the stream; a refreshed client needs replay or persisted state.
